native-no-store-fixed:
    if: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.native_no_store_fixed == 'true' }}
    needs: [plan]
    env:
      ADTR_E2E_NATIVE_STREAM_MODE: native-finish
    # Isolated upstream-fix diagnostic; the pinned baseline and matrix stay intact.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24.19.0'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      - name: Install locked browser test dependencies
        run: npm ci --prefix web --cache /tmp/adtr-npm-cache
      - name: Install headed browser system dependencies
        run: cd web && npx playwright install-deps chromium
      - name: Verify official fixed-build diagnostic browser
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          fixture="$RUNNER_TEMP/adtr-native-fixed"
          mkdir -p "$fixture"
          archive="$fixture/chrome-linux64.zip"
          curl --fail --show-error --silent --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 2 --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
            'https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/157.0.8092.0/linux64/chrome-linux64.zip' -o "$archive"
          test "$(stat -c %s "$archive")" -eq 201751736
          printf '%s  %s\n' '28d4f185c9047a91fe79ee8d31e5e0b5b858fc107129b3df361fdd095dbb2ace' "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
          unzip -q "$archive" -d "$fixture"
          chrome="$fixture/chrome-linux64/chrome"
          version="$("$chrome" --version | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          test "$version" = 'Google Chrome for Testing 157.0.8092.0'
          printf 'ADTR_E2E_CHROMIUM_PATH=%s\n' "$chrome" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          {
            printf 'channel=Dev\nversion=%s\n' "$version"
            printf 'source_tag=2b9f0645d8f651a36f74683f22a3746379f13bc6\n'
            printf 'engine_fix=62473ad0f747e245e514c93e741bb8e168a2a207\n'
            sha256sum "$archive" web/e2e/native-no-store-completion.spec.ts web/e2e/native-stream-proof.ts web/e2e/user-assets-v2.spec.ts web/e2e/user-assets-v2-readers.spec.ts web/e2e/user-assets-v3.spec.ts web/e2e/computer-assets-v3.spec.ts web/e2e/computer-assets-v3-readers.spec.ts web/e2e/computer-assets-v3-fixture.ts web/e2e/computer-assets-v3-helpers.ts web/e2e/group-assets-v3.spec.ts web/e2e/group-assets-v3-readers.spec.ts web/e2e/group-assets-v3-fixture.ts web/e2e/group-assets-v3-helpers.ts web/e2e/user-assets-v2-held-response.ts web/e2e/directory-v2-response-observer.ts web/src/directory-v2-json.ts
          } > "$fixture/provenance.txt"
          cat "$fixture/provenance.txt"
      - name: Require identical native stream proof on the fixed engine
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run test:e2e --prefix web -- e2e/native-no-store-completion.spec.ts --headed
      - name: Validate both production readers and exact native evidence
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: python3 scripts/validate_directory_v4_controls_evidence.py --source-root . --native
      - name: Retain fixed-build synthetic diagnostics and provenance
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: native-no-store-fixed-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/test-results/**/native-no-store-completion.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/adtr-native-fixed/provenance.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
